packs.name: 看医生
packs.intro: 前台登记、和医生描述症状：哪里不舒服、多久了、多严重。听不懂就请医生说慢一点。

dialog.t: Hi, do you have an appointment?
Yes, at nine thirty. My name is Steve Liu.
dialog.zh: 有，九点半。我叫 Steve Liu。

dialog.t: Can I see your insurance card and ID?
dialog.zh: 能看下你的保险卡和身份证件吗？

dialog.t: Sure, here you go.
So, what brings you in today?
My lower back hurts when I bend down.
How long has this been going on?
About two weeks. It's worse in the morning.
dialog.zh: 大概两个星期，早上更厉害。

dialog.t: On a scale of one to ten, how bad is it?
Maybe a six.
I'd like to get an X-ray to be safe.
dialog.zh: 保险起见我想拍个 X 光。

dialog.t: Okay. Could you speak a little slower, please?

phrases.t: I'd like to make an appointment.
I'm a new patient.
I have a fever and a sore throat.
It started three days ago.
It hurts right here.
The pain comes and goes.
I'm allergic to penicillin.
I'm not taking any medication right now.
Is it serious?
Do I need to come back?
Can I still go to work?
Could you write that down for me?
I need a doctor's note for work.
phrases.zh: 我需要一张给公司的病假条。

phrases.t: Could you speak a little slower, please?

packs.name: 药房取药
packs.intro: 去药房取处方药：报名字和生日，问价格、怎么吃、有没有副作用。

dialog.t: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription.
Last name and date of birth?
Liu, L-I-U. March fifth, nineteen eighty-two.
Okay, it's ready. Your copay is ten dollars.
How often should I take it?
Twice a day, with food.
Are there any side effects?
It might make you a little sleepy.
Can I drive after taking it?
Better not until you know how it affects you.
dialog.zh: 最好先别，等你知道它对你影响多大。

dialog.t: Got it. Thank you.

phrases.t: I'm here to pick up a prescription.
I'd like to drop off a prescription.
When will it be ready?
How much is it with my insurance?
Is there a cheaper generic version?
phrases.zh: 有便宜一点的非专利药吗？

phrases.t: How many times a day should I take this?
Should I take it with food?
Can I take this with my other medicine?
phrases.zh: 这个能和我的其他药一起吃吗？

phrases.t: Are there any side effects?
Can I get a refill?
Where can I find cold medicine?
Do you need my insurance card?
Can I get the flu shot here?

packs.name: DMV 办事
packs.intro: 去 DMV 换驾照、车辆过户、注册续期。先说办什么、有没有预约，准备好证件。

dialog.t: Next. What can I help you with?
I need to renew my driver's license.
Do you have an appointment?
Yes, at ten forty. Here's my confirmation.
dialog.zh: 有，十点四十。这是确认单。

dialog.t: Okay. Did you fill out the application online?
Yes, I did.
Great. Look into the camera for your photo.
Now read the third line on the eye chart.
E, F, P, T, O, Z.
Good. Your new license will come in the mail.
How long will that take?
Usually two to three weeks.

phrases.t: I need to renew my driver's license.
I'd like to make an appointment.
I'm here to transfer a car title.
I need to renew my registration.
I changed my address.
Which line should I wait in?
What documents do I need?
Do I need to take a written test?
Can I pay with a debit card?
Is there a late fee?
Can I get a temporary license?
When will I get it in the mail?
Sorry, which window did you call?
phrases.zh: 不好意思，你叫的是几号窗口？

packs.name: 银行
packs.intro: 在银行开户、存支票、转账、问可疑扣款。说清要办什么，涉及卡号只报后四位。

dialog.t: Hi, how can I help you today?
I'd like to deposit this check.
Sure. Into checking or savings?
dialog.zh: 好的。存到支票账户还是储蓄账户？

dialog.t: Checking, please.
Can I see your ID?
Here you go. Also, I have a question about a charge.
dialog.zh: 给你。另外我想问一笔扣款。

dialog.t: What's the charge?
There's a forty-dollar charge I don't recognize.
dialog.zh: 有一笔四十美元的扣款我不认识。

dialog.t: Let me take a look. It's from an online store.
dialog.zh: 我看一下，是一个网店的。

dialog.t: I didn't buy anything there. Can you block my card?
dialog.zh: 我没在那买过东西。能把我的卡冻结吗？

dialog.t: Yes, I'll cancel it and order a new one.
dialog.zh: 可以，我把它注销，给你补一张新的。

phrases.t: I'd like to open a checking account.
I'd like to deposit this check.
I need to withdraw two hundred dollars.
What's my balance?
I'd like to transfer money to savings.
I don't recognize this charge.
I think my card was stolen.
Can you freeze my card?
The card ends in four two seven one.
When will the money be available?
Are there any monthly fees?
How do I set up direct deposit?
Can I get a cashier's check?

packs.name: 打客服电话
packs.intro: 打客服：听语音菜单按键，说 representative 转人工，等待时要记下参考号（reference number）。

dialog.t: Please say or enter your account number.
dialog.zh: 请说出或输入你的账号。

dialog.t: Representative.
Please hold for the next available agent.
dialog.zh: 请稍候，下一位客服为您服务。

dialog.t: Thanks for holding. How can I help you?
dialog.zh: 感谢等候，有什么可以帮您？

dialog.t: Hi, my internet has been down since last night.
dialog.zh: 你好，我家网从昨晚就断了。

dialog.t: Sorry about that. Can I have your name?
Steve Liu. The account is under my name.
I see an outage in your area.
dialog.zh: 我看到您那个区域有故障。

dialog.t: When will it be fixed?
By six tonight. I'll credit your account.
dialog.zh: 今晚六点前。我会给您账户补偿。

dialog.t: Thanks. Can I get a reference number?
dialog.zh: 谢谢。能给我一个参考号吗？

dialog.t: Sure. It's R-four-five-eight-two.

phrases.t: Representative.
phrases.note: 语音菜单听不懂就说这个

phrases.t: I'd like to speak to a person, please.
I'm calling about my bill.
I was charged twice this month.
I'd like to cancel my service.
Can you explain this charge?
phrases.zh: 能解释一下这笔费用吗？

phrases.t: Sorry, I didn't catch that.
Could you repeat that slowly?
Can I get a reference number?
Can I speak to a supervisor?
I've been on hold for forty minutes.
phrases.zh: 我已经等了四十分钟了。

phrases.t: If we get cut off, can you call me back?
phrases.zh: 如果断线了，你能打回给我吗？

phrases.t: Can you send me an email confirmation?
phrases.zh: 能给我发一封确认邮件吗？

phrases.t: Thanks, you've been very helpful.

packs.name: 修车
packs.intro: 去修车店描述问题（异响、警示灯、刹车），问报价和取车时间，没同意前别让他们先修。

dialog.t: Hi, what's going on with the car?
The check engine light came on yesterday.
dialog.zh: 昨天发动机故障灯亮了。

dialog.t: And there's a squeaking noise when I brake.
dialog.zh: 刹车的时候还有吱吱声。

dialog.t: We'll run a diagnostic and check the brakes.
dialog.zh: 我们做个检测，再查一下刹车。

dialog.t: How much is the diagnostic?
It's ninety-nine dollars.
Okay. Please call me before doing any repairs.
dialog.zh: 好。修之前请先给我打电话。

dialog.t: Sure. We'll give you an estimate first.
dialog.zh: 当然，我们会先给你报价。

dialog.t: When do you think it'll be ready?
Probably by the end of the day.

phrases.t: The check engine light is on.
It's making a weird noise.
The brakes are squeaking.
The car pulls to the right.
The AC isn't blowing cold air.
I need an oil change.
Can you give me an estimate?
Please call me before you do any work.
phrases.zh: 修之前请先给我打电话。

phrases.t: Is it safe to drive?
Is this covered by the warranty?
When can I pick it up?
Can I see the old parts?
phrases.zh: 能看看换下来的旧零件吗？

phrases.t: Can you check the tire pressure too?

packs.name: 找房东/报修
packs.intro: 给房东或物业报修：说清什么坏了、从什么时候、严重程度，约维修时间，最好也发短信留记录。

dialog.t: Hi, this is Steve from unit B.
dialog.zh: 你好，我是 B 单元的 Steve。

dialog.t: Hi Steve. What's up?
The kitchen sink is leaking under the cabinet.
dialog.zh: 厨房水槽下面的柜子里漏水。

dialog.t: How bad is it?
It's dripping all the time. I put a bucket under it.
dialog.zh: 一直在滴，我放了个桶接着。

dialog.t: Okay. I'll send a plumber tomorrow.
dialog.zh: 好，我明天叫水管工过去。

dialog.t: What time will he come?
Between nine and noon.
I'll be at work. Can he use the lockbox?
dialog.zh: 我在上班。他能用钥匙盒吗？

dialog.t: Sure. I'll text you when he's done.
dialog.zh: 可以，他修好了我给你发短信。

dialog.t: Thanks. I'll send you a photo of the leak.
dialog.zh: 谢谢，我把漏水的照片发给你。

phrases.t: Something's wrong with the water heater.
There's no hot water.
The toilet keeps running.
The AC stopped working.
There's a leak under the sink.
The smoke alarm keeps beeping.
I think we have ants in the kitchen.
When can someone come take a look?
phrases.zh: 什么时候能有人来看看？

phrases.t: Can you let me know before you come in?
phrases.zh: 进门前能提前告诉我吗？

phrases.t: I'll send you a photo.
When is the rent due this month?
phrases.zh: 这个月房租什么时候交？

phrases.t: Can I pay the rent online?
I'd like to renew my lease.

packs.name: 餐厅和得来速
packs.intro: 得来速对着话筒点餐要清楚、慢一点；餐厅里点菜、问推荐、要打包、买单。

dialog.t: Welcome! What can I get for you?
Can I get a number three, please?
What size?
Medium, with a Coke.
Anything else?
Can I also get a small fries, no salt?
dialog.zh: 再要一个小薯条，不要盐。

dialog.t: Sure. Will that be all?
That's it, thanks.
Your total is twelve forty. Please pull up.
Can I get some extra ketchup?

phrases.t: Can I get a number two, please?
Can I get that with no onions?
Make it a large.
That's all, thanks.
Sorry, can you repeat that?
Table for two, please.
What do you recommend?
Is this spicy?
Can I get a box for this?
Can we get the check, please?
Can we split the check?
I think there's a mistake on the bill.
I ordered this without cheese.
Can I get a refill?

packs.name: Costco 退换货
packs.intro: 到 Costco 退换货柜台：说明东西有什么问题，带会员卡和小票，问退款方式。

dialog.t: Hi, what are you returning today?
This vacuum. It stopped working after a week.
dialog.zh: 这个吸尘器，用了一周就坏了。

dialog.t: Do you have your membership card?
Yes, here it is. I have the receipt too.
Would you like a refund or an exchange?
Can I exchange it for the same one?
We're out of stock right now, sorry.
Then a refund, please.
It'll go back on your card in a few days.
dialog.zh: 几天内会退回你的卡上。

dialog.t: Okay, thank you.

phrases.t: I'd like to return this.
It stopped working after a week.
It's missing some parts.
I don't have the receipt.
Can you look it up with my membership card?
phrases.zh: 能用我的会员卡查一下吗？

phrases.t: Can I exchange it for a different size?
I'd like a refund, please.
I opened the box, but I never used it.
phrases.zh: 盒子打开了，但我没用过。

phrases.t: Where's the returns counter?
Will the refund go back on my card?
How long does the refund take?
Is this item still on sale?
Do you have this in stock?

packs.name: 打 911
packs.intro: 只在紧急情况打 911。保持冷静，先报地址（位置最重要），再说发生了什么、有没有人受伤，别先挂电话。

dialog.t: 911, what's the address of your emergency?
Twelve fifty West Foothill Boulevard, Upland.
dialog.zh: Upland 西 Foothill 大道 1250 号。

dialog.t: What's going on?
There's been a car accident. Two cars.
Is anyone hurt?
Yes, one driver is bleeding from the head.
Is he awake and breathing?
Yes, he's awake and talking.
Help is on the way. Stay on the line.
dialog.zh: 救援在路上了，别挂电话。

dialog.t: Okay. I'm staying with him.

phrases.t: I need an ambulance.
I need the police.
There's a fire.
My address is twelve fifty West Foothill Boulevard.
phrases.zh: 我的地址是西 Foothill 大道 1250 号。
phrases.note: 地址先说，一个数字一个数字说清楚

phrases.t: I'm at the corner of Euclid and Foothill.
phrases.zh: 我在 Euclid 和 Foothill 交叉口。

phrases.t: I'm on the 10 freeway, heading east.
phrases.zh: 我在 10 号高速上，往东开。

phrases.t: Someone is hurt.
He's not breathing.
She's unconscious.
There's been a car accident.
I smell gas in the house.
My phone number is nine zero nine, five five five, zero one two three.
I'll stay on the line.
I need a Mandarin interpreter.

packs.name: 邻居寒暄
packs.intro: 和邻居打招呼、自我介绍、聊几句，也练习客气地提要求（停车、噪音、帮忙收快递）。

dialog.t: Hi there! Did you just move in?
Yes, last week. I'm Steve.
Nice to meet you. I'm Linda, from next door.
dialog.zh: 很高兴认识你，我是隔壁的 Linda。

dialog.t: Nice to meet you too. How long have you lived here?
dialog.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。你在这住多久了？

dialog.t: About ten years. It's a quiet street.
dialog.zh: 大概十年了，这条街很安静。

dialog.t: That's good to hear. Which day is trash pickup?
Tuesday morning. Put the bins out Monday night.
dialog.zh: 周二早上，周一晚上把桶放出去。

dialog.t: Thanks for the tip.
Let me know if you need anything.
Thanks, same here. Have a good evening.
dialog.zh: 谢谢，我也一样。晚上愉快。

phrases.t: Hi, I'm Steve. I just moved in next door.
phrases.zh: 你好，我是 Steve，刚搬到隔壁。

phrases.t: Nice to meet you.
How's it going?
Beautiful day, isn't it?
Your garden looks great.
Which day is trash pickup?
Could you keep an eye on my place this weekend?
phrases.zh: 这周末能帮我照看一下房子吗？

phrases.t: Could you grab my packages while I'm away?
phrases.zh: 我不在时能帮我收一下快递吗？

phrases.t: Would you mind not parking in front of my driveway?
phrases.zh: 能不能别停在我车道前面？

phrases.t: Sorry, was I too loud last night?
Let me know if you need anything.
Have a good one!
See you around.

packs.name: 保险公司打电话
packs.intro: 给保险公司打电话：报保单号、报理赔（claim）、问保费和免赔额。记下理赔号和处理人名字。

dialog.t: Thank you for calling. How can I help you?
dialog.zh: 感谢来电，有什么可以帮您？

dialog.t: I need to file a claim. Someone hit my car.
dialog.zh: 我要报理赔，有人撞了我的车。

dialog.t: I'm sorry to hear that. Is everyone okay?
Yes, nobody was hurt.
Can I have your policy number?
Sure. It's A-B, seven seven three, four one nine.
When and where did it happen?
dialog.zh: 什么时候在哪里发生的？

dialog.t: Yesterday around five, in a parking lot in Upland.
dialog.zh: 昨天五点左右，在 Upland 一个停车场。

dialog.t: Did you get the other driver's information?
dialog.zh: 你拿到对方司机的信息了吗？

dialog.t: Yes, I have his name, insurance, and license plate.
dialog.zh: 拿到了，有他的名字、保险和车牌。

dialog.t: Great. Your claim number is C-two-two-eight-one.
dialog.zh: 好的，您的理赔号是 C2281。

dialog.t: Thanks. Who will be handling my claim?

phrases.t: I'd like to file a claim.
My policy number is A-B, seven seven three, four one nine.
I was in a car accident.
It wasn't my fault.
I have photos of the damage.
What's my deductible?
Does my policy cover a rental car?
Why did my premium go up?
I'd like to add a driver to my policy.
phrases.zh: 我想在保单上加一个司机。

phrases.t: Can I get a quote for home insurance?
phrases.zh: 能给我报个房屋保险的价吗？

phrases.t: What's my claim number?
Who is my adjuster?
How long will this take?
Can you email me a copy of my policy?
phrases.zh: 能把保单副本发邮件给我吗？
